domain: FUNDAMENTALS-INVESTMENT/ISSUANCE (real-asset investment / capital-deployment channel; distinct from SFV8-A5-1's external-equity-supply channel - different fields, different forced-trader population, different failure modes)
title: PIT asset-growth inertia: short fastest asset expanders, long asset-contraction names, within-sector on the multi-vintage SEC panel

mechanism_question.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow: Two slow parties: (i) managers, who cannot rapidly disinvest committed capital - adjustment costs keep an expanded asset base in place for years, so the denominator (assets) and the marginal-return drag persist long after the investment decision; (ii) benchmarked growth managers and index committees, who carry names whose weights rose alongside their asset expansion and re-optimizing them only at calendar rebalances.
mechanism_question.why_the_effect_exists: q-theory predicts high past investment lowers expected returns because the marginal project earns a lower quasirent, and agency/overconfidence biases produce overinvestment at cyclical peaks (Cooper-Gulen-Schill 2008); investors extrapolate recent asset growth into persistent growth instead of discounting diminishing returns (Titman-Wei-Xie 2004), so expansion names are overpriced at the margin and correction takes multiple quarters.
mechanism_question.what_observable_measures_it: The 12-month log change in us-gaap:Assets, read PIT as the as-of vintage at decision t versus the same funded clock evaluated one year earlier, on the multi-vintage panel (never latest-in-store).
mechanism_question.when_it_must_fail: (a) If the premium is a stale-vintage artifact it dies when the Assets age bound is tightened from <=120 to a shorter effective freshness, or if it requires the unbounded clock; (b) if it is tangible-capex-specific or balance-sheet-size-specific rather than a real-investment effect, the neighbour (PP&E gross growth) and the placebo (AOCI change) split the result wrongly: placebo reproduction falsifies the family outright; (c) if it is sector or market beta, risk-matched SPY and sector-ETF excess go non-positive in >= 2 folds; (d) if it is a microstructure artifact it concentrates in band C and dies at 2x stress cost.
mechanism_question.what_control_kills_convenient_explanatio: The us-gaap:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax 12-month change placebo: it is a dense, same-statement balance-sheet change series driven by FX/pension/securities revaluation marks (repricing, not real investment); if a same-form book on AOCI changes reproduces the asset-growth spread, the convenient explanation 'any annual balance-sheet change sorts returns' wins and the family is abandoned, no rescue.

falsifiable_prediction: Within the P3-eligible universe and within each panel sector label s, the top asset-growth quintile (fastest 12m growth of us-gaap:Assets) underperforms the bottom quintile (asset contraction) over the following quarter on a long-short book. Preregistered pass conditions are exactly the Stage-A gates of p3_invariants_freeze.json: expectancy > 0, position PF >= 1.1, >= 2 of 3 folds positive, max fold MDD <= 0.15, risk-matched SPY excess positive in >= 2 folds, anchor overall alpha > 0, placebo |alpha| < 0.5 x anchor |alpha|. The prediction is falsified if any gate fails, if the neighbour (PP&E gross growth) carries the opposite sign (which would localize the effect to non-tangible asset expansion and break the q-theory reading), or if the AOCI-change placebo reproduces the anchor.
literature: Cooper, M.J., Gulen, H. and Schill, M.J. (2008), 'Asset Growth and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 63(4)
Titman, S., Wei, K.C.J. and Xie, F. (2004), 'Capital Investments and Stock Returns', Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 39(4)
Lyandres, E., Sun, L. and Zhang, L. (2008), 'The New Issues Puzzle: Testing the Investment-Based Explanation', Review of Financial Studies 21(6)
Xing, Y. (2008), 'Interpreting the Value Effect through the Q-Theory: An Empirical Investigation', Review of Financial Studies 21(4)
Lemmon, M.L., Roberts, M.R. and Zender, J.F. (2008), 'Back to the Beginning: Persistence and the Cross-Section of Corporate Capital Structure', Journal of Finance 63(4)
Cochrane, J.H. (1991), 'Production-Based Asset Pricing and the Link Between Stock Returns and Economic Fluctuations', Journal of Finance 46(1)

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.panel: .staging_sec_v8/multivintage_panel.jsonl (3,817,158 records / 410 filers, sha256 1cb115d3...); row schema {e, s, f, u, v, eff, avail}

anchor_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t with age <= 120 days

unbounded_robustness_leg_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t (unbounded)

neighbour_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t with age <= 400 days

placebo_clock_verbatim.clock: latest filed vintage as of t with age <= 400 days

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.signal: signal(t) = ln( A_asof(t) / A_asof(t - 1y) ), where A_asof(x) is the newest vintage of the cited field with avail < session_gate_utc(x) and age <= 120 days (identical funded clock evaluated at both legs; t-1y = the census decision date four quarters earlier); the 120-day bound is the tightest funded bound for this field, so the anchor is deliberately the freshest-vintage form
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.availability_semantics: gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session (research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.session_gate_utc); SEC filed dates are date-only, availability = end of the filed UTC day; a decision at t never reads a row with avail >= gate(t) and never reads latest-in-store; census facts: us-gaap:Assets 410/410 filers with any history, 55,562 records, availability lag mean 186.75 / p50 121 / max 1523 days, at-end coverage 0.9976; us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross 336/410 filers, 22,489 records, lag mean 175.5 / p50 116, at-end 0.8171; us-gaap:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax 398/410 filers, 56,555 records, lag mean 216.55 / p50 127, at-end 0.9707 (p0a_coverage_census.json)
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.prices: EODHD RAW daily bars readable at session close + 1 session; ADV63 = median(close*volume) over 63 sessions ending at the decision session

aggregation_declaration.note: Per-name ranks only; no SectorObservation / math.fsum sector aggregate consumed. Panel row sector label s (frozen 11-sector ETF mapping, research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.SECTOR_UNIVERSE) used only for within-sector rank demeaning.

conditional_declaration_if_sector_aggreg.aggregation: single-vintage equal-weight mean over sorted filers via math.fsum, coverage = filers_included/filers_mapped reported per observation (p3 pit_conditioning_v5 semantics)

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.eligibility_per_p3_floor: filer in the frozen 410-filer panel (sha256 1cb115d3...) AND servable per p2_coverage_first.json per_name (409 priced names; 373 ACTIVE_FILER + 37 TERMINATED_REGISTRATION with price files; 1837 S0 sessions each measured) AND ADV63 >= 2_000_000 USD (band C or better) at the decision AND RAW price >= 1.00 USD at the decision; p2 cited band populations: start {A:286, B:94, C:10, UNTRADABLE:4, NO_DATA:15}, mid {A:307, B:87, C:11, UNTRADABLE:3, NO_DATA:1}, end {A:376, B:31, C:1, UNTRADABLE:1}
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup: the prior-year leg requires a vintage of the same field with avail < gate(t-1y); at the first four S0 decisions (2018-04-04 through 2019-01-03) this leg is pre-S0 panel history with coverage unmeasured by the census (reported at scoring, not assumed); from 2019-04-04 both legs are measured census dates; names lacking either leg are excluded at that decision only, never backfilled
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.rebalance_clock: quarterly on the 30 census decision dates (2018-04-04 .. 2025-05-23), the exact dates on which the cited FUNDED_CANDIDATE clocks were measured; per-fold decisions 10 / 10 / 10
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding_period: one quarter per decision (~63 sessions), continuous re-formation with quintile rank buffers; membership carried unless the name exits its band or fails eligibility
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fills: signals computed on session t close data (PIT); fills at the next allowed session open-adjacent close-to-close execution (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK); no same-session fill; cost charged exactly once per side

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: 12m log growth of us-gaap:Assets (funded clock age <= 120), long bottom-growth quintile / short top-growth quintile, demeaned within panel sector s
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: identical construction on us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross 12m growth (funded clock age <= 400, pooled coverage 0.6909): tangible capital deployment (capex-style accumulation in the PP&E base) - the channel through which the q-theory story operates; neighbour SUPPORTS only if same sign; its sub-0.8-floor coverage (0 dates at the 0.8 floor) is a declared weakness that is why it is the neighbour, not the anchor
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.placebo_causal_control: 12m change of us-gaap:AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax (funded clock age <= 400, pooled coverage 0.913), same portfolio form, sign-convention-normalized (short top AOCI-growth treated symmetrically to test both orientations in the diagnostic, primary prediction is a null spread)
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.intended_correlation_profile_L7: The AOCI change-series is dense but driven by FX translation, pension and securities revaluation marks concentrated in cross-border filers and DB-pension sponsors - a driver population disjoint from the capital-deployment decisions that move total assets; a filer can show large AOCI swings with zero investment and large asset growth with zero AOCI movement, so ranks are expected near-orthogonal and the placebo spread economically null (|alpha| < 0.5 x anchor alpha per p3 control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt). It shares the filing statement surface with the anchor while removing real investment, so a reproduced spread isolates 'balance-sheet change' as the driver and falsifies the family. Correlation profile declared ex ante, never argued post hoc.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.falsification_rule: if the placebo reproduces the anchor spread, or if the diagnostic stale-leg variant (anchor leg lagged one extra year) outperforms the fresh anchor, the family is recorded FAIL with no rescue variant

incremental_alpha_test.vs_spy: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY adjusted total return scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule), reported per fold and overall; gates risk_matched_excess_positive_folds_ge 2 and anchor_overall_alpha_gt 0
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_etf: benchmark excess vs the equal-weight total return of the frozen 11 sector ETFs (SECTOR_UNIVERSE XLB..XLY, authorized EODHD data); the sector-ETF leg is a measurement benchmark only, never a traded momentum leg (A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM stays closed)
incremental_alpha_test.gates: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; >= 2 of 3 folds positive; min populated fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15 (not negotiable); margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2)

base_and_stress_costs.model: p3 v8 liquidity-band cost model: bands by trailing 63-session median dollar volume as-of each decision; cost linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL, never a sidecar
base_and_stress_costs.expected_blended_estimate_from_cited_ban: panel-weighted base per side = start (286x10 + 94x15 + 10x25)/390 = 11.6 bps; mid (307x10 + 87x15 + 11x25)/405 = 11.3 bps; end (376x10 + 31x15 + 1x25)/408 = 10.4 bps; stress = 2x each (20.8-23.2 bps per side); these are arithmetic blends of cited p2 band populations, not measured arm composition; realized band mix reported at scoring
base_and_stress_costs.annual_drag_estimate: at declared expected two-way turnover <= 3.0/yr, base drag <= ~35 bps of gross, stress <= ~70 bps of gross

turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected), annualized two-way, raw and ceiling-normalized both reported
turnover_and_sample_floor.declared_expectation: quarterly decisions on an annual-growth signal with quintile buffers: expected two-way turnover <= 3.0/yr, binding ceiling 6.0/yr; the anchor vintage refreshes at most quarterly per filer, so membership is persistent by construction
turnover_and_sample_floor.sample_floor: 30 quarterly decision dates total (>= 30 scored decisions, p3 min_decisions_total), 10 per fold (>= 5 per fold); at least 1 non-CASH leg per decision or the decision abstains
turnover_and_sample_floor.accounting: long/short books separate, gross/net/cash reconciled to 1.0 within 1e-9; CASH never a symbol; no cross-fold carry

mandated_by_p3: drop-one symbol: value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival = after-drop expectancy > 0
drop-one fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival = min > 0
drop_one_design.ingredient_drop_one: rerun the anchor book with us-gaap:Assets removed and only the neighbour us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross driving ranks (tangible-investment-only form); additionally rerun with the age bound relaxed 120 -> 400 days (stale-vintage sensitivity check; the 120-day anchor must not depend on the looser bound to survive)
drop_one_design.no_post_hoc_arms: all reruns above are declared here, ex ante; no additional arm may be added after any PnL is scored

failure_interpretation.anchor_fail_neighbour_pass: total-assets label artifact; tangible-investment reading survives only as evidence, family recorded FAIL for the anchor
failure_interpretation.placebo_reproduces: generic balance-sheet-change exposure, not real-investment mispricing - family falsified, no re-parameterization, no rename, no rescue variant
failure_interpretation.neighbour_opposite_sign: effect localized to non-tangible (e.g. acquisition) expansion; q-theory reading falsified; recorded FAIL for the investment mechanism
failure_interpretation.pass_only_in_band_C: liquidity-cost artifact; 2x stress rerun must also pass or recorded FAIL
all failures carry margin-to-fail reporting per LESSONS P-2

forbidden_inventory_screen.A5-SFV2-TREND-DEFENSIVE: CLEAN - no SMA/EMA/trend filters, no vol targeting, no defensive rotation
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL: CLEAN - no idiosyncratic shock/crash/overshoot term; the signal never reads prices
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE: CLEAN - no calendar timing mechanism; quarterly census decision dates exist because the funded clocks were measured on them, and the mechanism is capital-deployment mispricing, not turn-of-month seasonality
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV4-A5-H1-PARTICIPATION-SHIFT: CLEAN - no dollar-volume or participation term; ADV63 used only for P3 eligibility and cost banding, never as a signal
forbidden_inventory_screen.SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE_and_vol_le: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION AND COMMITTED TO MEASUREMENT - no variance/semivariance/vol-level term; anchor ranks are functions of filed asset levels only, sharing zero source fields with the V4 semivariance-SHAPE anchor and the V4 vol-level control, so the V6 measured-closed region (rho 0.319 > 0.20) is not entered by design; a pre-selection A7-N rank-correlation check vs BOTH V4 anchors is committed, and the arm is abandoned if |rho| > 0.20 measured before any selection
forbidden_inventory_screen.EQ_S2_A3_F1_PIT_RECON_FLOW: DISTINCT - that frozen family is PIT reconstruction/flow (investor-flow reconstruction, never scored); this proposal uses as-of filed fundamentals growth from the frozen 154-clock set (the exact channel the V8 packet mandates) and reconstructs no flow
forbidden_inventory_screen.A5-S2-F1-LENDING-CONSTRAINT-PREMIUM: CLEAN - no securities-lending, borrow or short-interest data
forbidden_inventory_screen.generic_mechanisms: CLEAN - no cross-sectional price momentum, no time-series trend, no earnings surprise/analyst revisions/institutional flows/quote-spread terms, no daily-indicator grid (one distinct economic mechanism on 30 quarterly decisions), no new accounts/paid data/network fetch
forbidden_inventory_screen.blocked_channels: CLEAN - only SEC EDGAR (multi-vintage panel) and EODHD All World (authorized, all six gates pass) are read; Massive Basic, Stooq bulk and per-symbol, and Twelve Data are not touched
forbidden_inventory_screen.rescue_variant_check: not a renamed vetoed family and not a price/volume mechanism wearing a fundamentals label: ablation of all price inputs leaves the signal vector unchanged; distinct from SFV8-A5-1 (different channel: internal capital deployment vs external share supply; different fields: Assets/PP&E vs share counts; different placebo family: AOCI marks vs authorized-share ceiling)

implementation_estimate.code: ~450-650 LOC on top of the untouched PIT bridge: panel filter on three fields, per-filer as-of vintage path on the 30 census dates, two-leg growth signal, quintile books with buffers, eligibility/band join, p3 book accounting; reuses existing factory conventions
implementation_estimate.cells: 1 anchor + 1 neighbour + 1 placebo + base/stress reruns + drop-one reruns; serial cells within the family; each cell well inside the 120-minute hard timeout on the staged 3.8M-row panel (three-field row filter)
implementation_estimate.risk: pre-S0 prior-year legs at the first four decisions have unmeasured coverage (reported at scoring); us-gaap:Assets availability lag max 1523 days means the 120-day bound drops slow filers at some decisions - exclusions are PIT-clean and reported; no new data dependencies
